sv.title: Kom igen, MFF-supportrar – en kris kan leda till något bra
sv.summary: MFF ligger i mitten av tabellen, och supportrarna har panik. I reportageseriens avslutande del skriver Filip Yifter-Svensson om en framgångsskadad klubb, vars moderna supporterkultur dock föddes genom en kris.

en.title: Come on, MFF supporters – a crisis can lead to something good
en.summary: MFF is in the middle of the table, and the supporters are panicking. In the concluding part of the report series, Filip Yifter-Svensson writes about a club hurt by its own success, whose modern supporter culture was, however, born out of a crisis.
